originality: This is an original design for an original game. It must not resemble or reference any character, creature, logo or artwork from existing games, anime, films or other franchises.

sprite.style: Game sprite in crisp, hand-placed pixel art in the manner of 16-bit-era role-playing games remastered with soft modern lighting: a limited palette, clean dark outlines one pixel wide that are never pure black, and a soft key light from the upper left. One character only, full body, standing, centred, with the whole figure visible and a generous margin. Flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shadow, floor, gradient or scenery. No text, watermark or border.

portrait.style: Dialogue portrait in crisp, high-detail pixel art for a 16-bit-era-inspired role-playing game remastered with soft modern lighting: a head-and-shoulders bust facing the viewer with the head turned very slightly toward the right of the image, an expressive and readable face with clear eyes, brows and mouth, a soft key light from the upper left, a limited palette with smooth hand-placed shading and clean outlines that are never pure black. The head is large and fills most of the picture; the shoulders are cut off by the bottom edge, with a narrow margin of background above the hair and at both sides. Flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shadow, glow or gradient. No text, watermark or frame.

prop.style: A single game prop in crisp pixel art for a cozy fantasy role-playing game, three-quarter top-down view, a soft key light from the upper left, a limited palette and clean outlines that are never pure black. Centred with a generous margin on a flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shadow or floor. No text or watermark.

concept.style: Character design reference sheet for a cozy fantasy creature role-playing game: the same character shown from the front, the back and the right side at the same scale, clean full-colour illustration with consistent proportions and colours on a plain light-grey background. No text labels.

environment.style: Concept painting of a location for a cozy pixel-art fantasy role-playing game presented as a lit miniature diorama: three-quarter top-down view, tilt-shift depth of field, soft volumetric light and a warm storybook palette. No text and no people unless described.

keyart.style: Key art for a cozy pixel-art fantasy role-playing game: rich, detailed pixel art with soft modern lighting and depth, painterly glow from light sources, a warm storybook mood. No text or logo.

sprite_hd.style: Game sprite in crisp, high-detail HD pixel art for a 16-bit-era-inspired role-playing game remastered with soft modern lighting: small, even, square pixels; a rich but limited palette with four to six hand-placed shades per material; clear form shading that gives the body real volume; a soft key light from the upper left; a clean dark outline one pixel wide that is never pure black. One creature only, full body, seen from slightly above as in a three-quarter top-down game, standing on an invisible floor, centred with a margin on every side. Flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shadow, floor, gradient or scenery. No text, watermark or border.
sprite_hd.framing: When it stands, the creature fills about four fifths of the picture height; in every pose it is drawn at that same scale.

wren.subject: Wren, a fourteen-year-old apprentice warden: tousled brown hair, warm tan skin, a short teal hooded cloak over a cream tunic, a red scarf, brown trousers, dark boots and a small leather satchel. Curious and kind, ready to set out.

wren_portrait.subject: Wren, a fourteen-year-old apprentice warden with a gentle, youthful face: a mop of tousled brown hair with a few spiky tufts on top and a soft fringe over the forehead, warm tan skin, big earnest brown eyes, a teal hooded cloak with the hood down around the shoulders, a red scarf wrapped at the neck, the collar of a cream tunic and a thin brown leather satchel strap across the chest.

expressions.neutral: calm and attentive, a faint friendly smile
expressions.smile: a bright, open smile, eyes crinkled with joy
expressions.determined: brows lowered and eyes narrowed with resolve, a small confident smile

hesper.subject: Warden Hesper, the elder warden of a forest village: a tall woman in her sixties with silver-grey hair in a low bun, light skin, a long plum-coloured coat over a cream blouse, sturdy leather shoes, leaning on a gnarled wooden staff. Warm and wry, with a stern edge.

hesper_portrait.subject: Warden Hesper, a woman in her sixties: silver-grey hair pulled up into a neat round bun high on the back of the head with a few loose strands at the temples, light skin with laugh lines, sharp kind blue-grey eyes behind small round gold-rimmed spectacles, a high-collared plum coat over a cream blouse with a soft ruffled collar, and a small gold clasp at the throat.

expressions.neutral: composed, a hint of a smile

corin.subject: Corin, a fourteen-year-old apprentice: deep brown skin, spiky copper-red hair under a red headband, a mustard-yellow vest over a grey shirt, blue trousers, leather boots and fingerless leather gloves. A confident grin; boastful but good-hearted.

corin_portrait.subject: Corin, a fourteen-year-old apprentice with a cocky, energetic look: deep brown skin, bright green eyes, a shock of spiky copper-orange hair standing up in flame-like points above a red cloth headband whose knotted tails hang at the right side of the head, a mustard-yellow vest with rounded padded shoulders over a slate-grey shirt with a dark high collar.

expressions.grin: a big, boastful grin showing teeth, eyes squeezed shut with laughter
expressions.determined: jaw set and brows lowered, a fierce, determined stare
expressions.sulk: a sulky pout, brows drawn together, eyes glancing aside

wynn.subject: Wynn, the cheerful village baker: round-faced and rosy, hair tied up under a red kerchief, sleeves rolled up, a flour-dusted cream apron, holding a loaf of bread.

bram.subject: Bram, a gruff old farmer: broad shoulders, a wide straw hat, grey stubble, a green work shirt with rolled sleeves, leather braces, earth-brown trousers, holding a wooden hoe.

sigilbinder.subject: A Sigilbinder: a silent hooded figure in a long, tattered ink-black cloak, the face lost in the hood's shadow except for two faint glowing eyes, with a glowing magenta chain of interlocking rune links wound around the right arm.

emberlyn.subject: Emberlyn, a small fire-element woodland creature: a long, low, stoat-like body with russet fur on the back and a cream underside and muzzle, a dark soot band across the eyes like a mask, soot-dark paws, small round ears, big amber eyes, and a long bushy tail that cradles a glowing ember coal in a ring of fur at its tip. Alert and a little timid.

stoneback.subject: Stoneback, a heavy stone-element creature: a compact, low, pangolin-like quadruped with overlapping slate-grey stone plates down its back, a thick ridge of moss with tiny white flowers along the spine, stubby warm-brown legs, a broad blunt snout, small glowing amber eyes under a heavy stone brow, and a short tail ending in a stone club. Sleepy, stubborn and sturdy.

mossling.subject: Mossling, a tiny shy grove-element creature: a round moss-covered puffball with long floppy leaf-shaped ears like a lop-eared rabbit, a tiny two-leaf sprout on its head, stubby feet, shiny dark eyes and a pinkish nose.

lanternmoth.subject: Lanternmoth, a large and gentle moth creature: dusky plum wings with violet-tinted edges and soft eye-spots, a fuzzy cream thorax, feathery antennae, and a softly glowing golden abdomen like a paper lantern. Hovering with wings spread.

emberlyn_concept.subject: Emberlyn, a small fire-element woodland creature: a long, low, stoat-like body with russet fur on the back and a cream underside and muzzle, a dark soot band across the eyes like a mask, soot-dark paws, small round ears, big amber eyes, and a long bushy tail that cradles a glowing ember coal in a ring of fur at its tip.

emberlyn_portrait.subject: Emberlyn, a small fire-element woodland creature, its head and chest: a stoat-like face with russet fur on the head and shoulders and a cream chest, cheeks and muzzle, a dark soot band across the eyes like a mask, small round russet ears, big amber eyes and a small dark nose. Its long bushy russet tail curls up behind one shoulder, and a ring of cream fur at the tip cradles a glowing ember flame.

expressions.scared: wide, frightened eyes with small pupils, ears pressed back, mouth slightly open, a bead of sweat at the brow
expressions.happy: eyes squeezed shut in a big happy smile, mouth open, cheeks flushed, the tail ember burning brighter

emberlyn_turnaround.subject: Emberlyn, a small fire-element woodland creature with a compact, rounded body that fits inside a square: a large rounded head with big amber eyes with white catchlights, a dark soot-grey band across the eyes like a mask, a cream muzzle, cheeks and chest, a small dark nose, and small rounded ears with cream inner fur; russet-orange fur on the head, back and legs with deeper russet shading; short sturdy legs ending in soot-dark paws; and a big bushy russet tail that sweeps up behind the back like a rising flame, about as tall as the body, ending in a ring of cream fur that cradles a glowing ember flame at the very top. Alert, quick and a little timid.

poses.stand: standing calmly on all four paws, relaxed and alert, head up, ears up, the bushy tail curving up behind the back with the ember burning softly at the top.
poses.ready: a low, springy battle stance on all four paws: front legs spread and braced, shoulders lowered, head held low and forward with the eyes fixed on a foe, ears forward, the bushy tail raised high and tense behind it with the ember blazing.
poses.walk_a: trotting, mid-stride: the near front paw and the far hind paw reach forward while the other two push back, head up, the tail bobbing behind.
poses.walk_b: trotting, mid-stride: the far front paw and the near hind paw reach forward while the other two push back, head up, the tail bobbing behind.
poses.crouch: coiled to spring forward: crouched very low on deeply bent legs, chest close to the floor, rump and tail raised, head low with narrowed eyes, every muscle tense.

leap.all: leaping forward at full speed, all four paws off the floor: the body stretched out long, front legs reaching forward, hind legs kicked back, ears flat, the tail streaming back with the ember flame flaring and trailing sparks.
leap.s: It leaps straight toward the viewer, so the body is strongly foreshortened: the head and reaching front paws are closest, the tail streams up and back behind it.
leap.n: It leaps straight away from the viewer: we see its back, the hind paws kicked back toward us, the tail streaming back toward us over the body.

poses.land: skidding to a stop after a leap: front legs braced stiffly forward, hind legs bent under the body, body tilted back, head up, the tail swinging forward over the back.
poses.ram: the moment of a head-first ram: shoulders hunched, head down butting forward, eyes squeezed shut, ears flat back, the body squashed short and compact, the tail whipped up with sparks flying from the ember.
poses.cast_wind: drawing a deep breath before breathing fire: chest puffed out, head pulled back a little, eyes narrowed, the tail ember glowing brighter.
poses.cast: breathing a burst of fire: standing firm, head thrust forward, mouth wide open with a small ball of bright flame at the mouth, the tail ember blazing brightly.
poses.melee_wind: winding up a claw swipe: weight shifted back onto the hind legs, one front paw raised high and pulled back, claws out, head low, teeth bared.
poses.melee: a fast claw swipe: lunging forward with one front paw slashing down and across, claws out, teeth bared, ears back.
poses.focus: sitting upright with the eyes closed in calm concentration, front paws together, the tail curled up beside the body, the ember glowing big, bright and steady.
poses.guard: bracing defensively: crouched low behind its raised bushy tail, which it curls around the front of its body like a shield, eyes peeking over the tail, ears flat.
poses.hurt: recoiling from a hit: flinching back with the eyes squeezed shut, ears flat back, the body twisted away, fur ruffled, the ember flickering.
poses.dizzy: dazed and dizzy: sitting back on its haunches with swirly, unfocused eyes, head tilted, mouth hanging open, the ember sputtering weakly.
poses.ko_fall: knocked out and toppling over onto its side, legs folding, eyes shut, the ember dimming.
poses.ko_lie: knocked out, lying flat on its side on the floor with the legs limp and the eyes shut, the ember only a faint glow.
poses.victory: celebrating a win: sitting up proudly on its hind legs with the chest puffed out and both front paws raised, eyes happily closed and mouth open in a cheer, the ember blazing big and bright.
poses.cower: frightened and cowering: crouched low and small, ears pressed back, wide frightened eyes, trembling, the tail tucked around itself, the ember small and weak.
poses.curl: curled up asleep in a tight ball on the floor with its bushy tail wrapped around itself like a blanket, eyes peacefully shut, the ember glowing softly at the tail tip.
poses.happy: jumping for joy: a happy little hop with all four paws off the floor, eyes squeezed shut in a big smile, mouth open, tail wagging, the ember blazing.

stoneback_turnaround.subject: Stoneback, a heavy stone-element creature like a small armadillo with a tall, high, rounded dome of a shell, a little taller than it is wide, like a rounded boulder: overlapping slate blue-grey stone plates in curved bands with chipped edges and faint cracks, a thick cushion of green moss with tiny white and pale-yellow flowers growing on the crown of the dome, a broad blunt warm-brown snout and face peeking out from under a heavy stone brow, small glowing amber eyes, stubby warm-brown legs with pale claws, and a short tail ending in a round stone club. In profile the body is short and compact, almost round, with the head tucked close under the front of the shell and the tail club tucked close behind, so every view fits inside a square. Sleepy, stubborn and sturdy.

stoneback_hd.framing: When it stands, the creature is about three fifths of the picture width wide; in every pose it is drawn at that same scale.
stoneback_hd.subject: Stoneback, a heavy stone-element creature like a small armadillo with a tall, high, rounded dome of a shell, a little taller than it is wide, like a rounded boulder: overlapping slate blue-grey stone plates in curved bands with chipped edges and faint cracks, a thick cushion of green moss with tiny white and pale-yellow flowers growing on the crown of the dome, a broad blunt warm-brown snout and face peeking out from under a heavy stone brow, small glowing amber eyes, stubby warm-brown legs with pale claws, and a short tail ending in a round stone club. In profile the body is short and compact, almost round, with the head tucked close under the front of the shell and the tail club tucked close behind, so every view fits inside a square. Sleepy, stubborn and sturdy.

poses.stand: standing calmly on its four stubby legs, head out under the brow, sleepy half-closed eyes.
poses.ready: a heavy, braced battle stance: legs planted wide, the shell lowered, head pushed forward under the stone brow with the glowing eyes fixed on a foe, the tail club raised.
poses.walk_a: plodding forward, mid-step: the near front leg and the far hind leg step forward while the other two push back.
poses.walk_b: plodding forward, mid-step: the far front leg and the near hind leg step forward while the other two push back.
poses.crouch: tucking in to roll: head and legs half pulled in under the shell, the shell lowered and curling forward, starting to become a ball.
poses.ball: rolled up completely into a tight, round stone ball: only the overlapping slate plates and the moss with its flowers are visible, no head or legs.
poses.land: coming out of its ball with a heavy thud: legs splayed out wide to brake, the shell still low and tilted forward, head popping out, dust kicked up.
poses.ram: the moment of a crushing shell-first ram: rolled into a tight ball and slammed into a foe, the ball squashed a little flat from the impact, with bits of stone and moss flying.
poses.cast_wind: rearing up on its hind legs to stamp, front legs lifted high, head raised, the moss on its back glowing a bright, soft green.
poses.cast: stamping down hard with both front legs to make the ground shake, the shell tilted forward, the moss glowing bright green, small rocks jumping up around its feet.
poses.melee_wind: swinging its tail club back for a strike, the body twisted, head turned to look at the target.
poses.melee: slamming its stone tail club around in a heavy swipe, the body twisted, the club at the end of the swing.
poses.focus: settled low with the legs tucked under and the eyes closed in calm concentration, the moss on its back glowing a soft bright green with tiny motes of light rising.
poses.guard: withdrawn into its shell for defence: head and legs pulled almost completely inside, the heavy stone brow and plates lowered to the floor like a fortress, eyes peeking out of the dark gap.
poses.hurt: flinching from a hit: the shell jolted and tilted back, eyes squeezed shut, mouth open in a grunt, a chip of stone flying off.
poses.dizzy: dazed and dizzy: wobbling with swirly, unfocused eyes, head drooping and tilted, legs splayed.
poses.ko_fall: knocked out and toppling over onto its back, legs in the air, eyes shut.
poses.ko_lie: knocked out, lying upside down on its shell with the stubby legs limp in the air and the eyes shut.
poses.victory: celebrating a win: rearing up proudly on its hind legs with the front legs raised, eyes happily closed, mouth open in a cheer, the flowers on its moss in full bloom.
poses.sleep: fast asleep: settled flat on its belly with the legs tucked under, eyes shut, head resting on the floor, peaceful.

training_totem_hd.subject: A training dummy for young creature tamers: a stout wooden post set in a heavy wooden foot, a short wooden crossbar for arms with rounded ends, a plump body of tied straw wrapped in a weathered burlap sack bound with twisted rope at the waist and neck, loose straw tufts poking out at the hem, a round burlap sack head with two stitched X eyes, and a painted red and cream bullseye target on the chest. Sturdy, homely and well used.

poses.hit_back: knocked back by a hit: the whole dummy tilts backward and to the right on its post, straw bits and dust burst from the chest.
poses.hit_forward: springing back after a hit: the whole dummy tilts forward and to the left on its post, a few loose straw bits still in the air.

poses.wings_down: hovering with its wings swept down and forward at the bottom of a wingbeat, the glowing abdomen hanging below.

sigilbinder_turnaround.subject: A Sigilbinder: a silent hooded figure in a long, tattered ink-black cloak, the face lost in the hood's shadow except for two faint glowing eyes, with a glowing magenta chain of interlocking rune links wound around the right arm.

sigilbinder_hd.subject: A Sigilbinder: a silent hooded figure in a long, tattered ink-black cloak, the face lost in the hood's shadow except for two faint glowing eyes, with a glowing magenta chain of interlocking rune links wound around the right arm.

poses.idle: standing perfectly still and upright, menacing and silent, arms hidden in the cloak except the chained right arm hanging at the side.
poses.run_a: running away fast, leaning forward, the left leg striding forward and the tattered cloak streaming out behind.
poses.run_b: running away fast, leaning forward, the right leg striding forward and the tattered cloak streaming out behind.

stoneback_concept.subject: Stoneback, a heavy stone-element creature: a compact, low, pangolin-like quadruped with overlapping slate-grey stone plates, a mossy spine ridge with tiny white flowers, stubby warm-brown legs, a broad blunt snout, small glowing amber eyes under a heavy stone brow and a short tail ending in a stone club.

mural_dawncrane.subject: An ancient carved stone wall mural seen straight on: Aurelune the Dawncrane, a mythic crane of dawn light with long sweeping wings and a crest like a rising sun, carved in relief with worn gold inlay, framed by weathered stone with creeping moss.

standing_stone.subject: A tall, weathered standing stone from an ancient dueling circle, patched with moss and faint carved spirals.

lantern_post.subject: A wooden village lantern post with a small iron lantern hanging from an arm, glowing warmly.

mossford_square.subject: Mossford, a small forest village in the morning: thatched timber-frame cottages around a cobblestone square with a stone well and a great old oak, a bakery with a warm window, flower boxes, mossy stone walls and a stream with a wooden footbridge to the west.

glimmerwood_clearing.subject: The Glimmerwood: an old forest clearing in soft morning light, glowing teal moss on roots and stones, a fallen hollow log, a ring of stones for a campfire, a shallow stream, fireflies and drifting mist.

ringstones.subject: The Ringstones: an ancient circle of mossy standing stones around a packed-sand dueling floor, wooden bleachers for villagers, braziers and cloth banners, in golden late-afternoon light.

dawn_shrine.subject: The Dawn Shrine at night: overgrown stone ruins at the forest's edge, a great carved mural of a crane-like creature of dawn on the back wall glowing faintly gold, a small reflecting pond, lantern light and stars.

title_keyart.subject: A young apprentice in a teal cloak and red scarf sits by a campfire in a forest clearing at dusk beside a small russet fox-like fire creature whose bushy tail holds a glowing ember; a large gentle moth with a softly glowing golden body rests on a branch nearby. Warm firelight against cool blue night, fireflies. Wide, calm composition: the campfire group is small and centred in the lower third of the picture, framed by tall dark tree trunks at the left and right edges, and the upper half is a quiet, dark dusky sky seen through the canopy with a few stars.
